about: The secreta of the formulary “Ascension of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer for the glorious Ascension of Thy Son, and graciously grant that we may be delivered from present dangers and attain unto everlasting life. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
